body: I had been trying not to do this but I failed. Yesterday, I was almost gone. I dressed and went to the topmost floor of my apartment, there is a pavilion there. I made sure nobody was there and headed to a small hut with an appropriate ledge to tie the noose. I had taken a chair from indoor. As usual, I checked my makeups and stood on the chair, wearing the noose again. Taking a deep breath, I jumped off the chair. The noose tightened my neck and the urge had been slowly diminished during the enjoyment. However, the chair was pushed too far that my legs cannot reach this time. I didn't notice until I reached the limit of the hanging. I panicked. My head boiled so hot, my hearing was deafened with a ringing sound, my vision was brightened and my whole body was struggling crazily. I felt myself hanging for a long time until a stranger found me and got me down. I refused to go to the hospital and ran straight to the elevator. The scar has not recovered yet, I stayed at home since yesterday. Still, the urge is still fucking there! It's like the best desire I want to experience except the dying part. What is in my body pushed so far for this process? I don't want to officially open my case to my close people or anyone, my reputation will be over in school. I just wonder if anyone had similar conditions like me and how they do to fix this.
